proposed.explanation: We recommend buying 400 shares of Abu Qir Fertilizers (ABUK) at the price of 76.21 EGP per share, utilizing 30,484.00 EGP of the available 40,000.00 EGP cash. This fulfills the investor's goal of adding a fertilizer exporter for diversification, aligning with their 5-year horizon and medium loss tolerance. Buying 400 shares of ABUK results in a holding value of 30,484.00 EGP, which represents approximately 46.47% of the total portfolio value.
